seed: A corridor of bureaucratic waiting rooms where each stamp of approval redacts a word from the applicant's petition, and the door only unlocks when the petition becomes completely illegible.

human_coordinates.what: Bureaucratic waiting corridor with progressive document redaction and procedural friction
human_coordinates.who: The applicant navigating statutory hurdles vs the sovereign archive
human_coordinates.where: Desktop and 390px mobile viewport in institutional parchment palette
human_coordinates.how: Procedural friction mu delays traversal; approval stamps lambda redact petition words to unlock the terminal door
human_coordinates.when: Four sequential chambers (Intake, Review, Censure, Archival) with manual still-state stepping

historical_references.summary: Synthetic commission specifying 4-gate bureaucratic waiting room with petition redaction.

candidates.formal_proposition: Materializes administrative resistance and institutional friction through procedural delay and archival omission.
structural_mechanisms: Baseline Cadence: Maps corridor into a structured recursive invariant
Counter-Pressure: Introduces bureaucratic as an aperiodic strain vector
Causal Interference: Measures observable displacement where corridor and bureaucratic collide
candidates.medium_consequence: In VISUAL, the work refuses singular closure by presenting distinct rival paths.

candidates.formal_proposition: Reframes the work through the sensory exhaustion of the delayed subject rather than the sovereign designer's blueprint.
structural_mechanisms: Procedural Inversion: Consequence displayed at ingress; terminal loss visible prior to operational cause
Friction Accounting: Each interaction demands explicit recognition of past energetic cost
Asymmetric Recovery: Historical traversal is fully recordable but structurally irreversible
candidates.medium_consequence: In VISUAL, the work subverts institutional arrival by foregrounding retained loss.

refractive_variant.mutation_description: Inverts the vantage point from sovereign bureaucratic gatekeeper to the affected citizen traversing the corridor.
refractive_variant.formal_consequence: Shifts from documenting administrative machinery to measuring the human exhaustion of delay.
refractive_variant.material_difference: The composition is framed through the citizen waiting room rather than the executive drafting chamber.
refractive_variant.instruction_trace: Reconstruct the physical and procedural friction from the standpoint of the delayed applicant.

shared_invariants: The core intellectual seed ("A corridor of bureaucratic waiting rooms where each stamp of approval redacts a word from the applicant's petition, and the door only unlocks when the petition becomes completely illegible.") is held invariant across both realizations
Both variants inhabit the declared medium: VISUAL
No scalar utility score or automatic aesthetic crown is applied
